title: shadow-eval-prober-for-kv-cache-output-disparities
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a lightweight "shadow" evaluation prober that runs live (or sampled) traffic variations through a non-invasive pipeline to detect KV/prefix cache hit-induced output disparities. This ticket focuses on the evaluation harness, sampling strategy, scoring heuristics, and automated alert thresholds — not on cache implementation fixes. Goal is earlier detection and contextualized debugging signals when cache hits change downstream text semantics or structured outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow prober can replay sampled production requests to a 'shadow path' that forces a KV cache hit and records the alternative output without affecting live responses
Scoring pipeline produces per-request delta metrics (token edit distance, embedding cosine delta, structured-field drift) and stores results in the eval index
Default thresholds for 'semantic regression' and 'minor divergence' set and configurable per-route in the dashboard
Prototype alert rule created: fires when 0.5% of requests in a 1h window exceed semantic-delta and are enriched with top-3 failing prompts
Playbook (runbook) for triage created with links to diagnostic artifacts, upstream config diffs, and suggested rollback steps
comments: 2026-02-22 - Asha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes: align on sampling budgets (0.1% live traffic target), privacy constraints, and data retention (30 days for debug artifacts). Action: Marcus to draft arch diagram.
2026-02-25 - Marcus Lee: Added initial prototype that forks requests into a shadow worker using existing request-fanout infra. See PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7890

2026-03-01 - Design review w/ PM and Security: approved redaction of PII before embedding comparisons and limit raw-response retention. Security asked for opt-out flag for enterprise customers; added config flag 'shadow_eval.enabled' scoped per-customer.

2026-03-05 - Marcus Lee: Benchmarked overhead: additional 0.07ms median CPU per sampled request when shadow path is local, and 6% extra network egress when sending full payloads to evaluation cluster. Plan: send compressed deltas and sampled token hashes to reduce cost.
2026-03-09 - Asha Patel: Updated acceptance criteria to include structured-field drift heuristics for function outputs and tool-calling traces. Follow-up: add unit tests for structured diff logic.

2026-03-10 - Marcus Lee: Integration test failed for long-context prompts (>16k). Temporary mitigation: cap shadow context length to 8k and add a ticket to investigate kernel-level mismatch (ENG-42198).
implementation_notes: Shadow worker runs in a separate process pool to avoid head-of-line blocking; must never alter live response path or add >2ms tail latency to production requests.
Sampling strategy: deterministic hash-by-request-id + time-window to ensure reproducible replays for debugging and A/B investigations.

Scoring: combine token-level normalized Levenshtein, embedding cosine distance (sentence-transformer small), and structured-key diffs (for JSON outputs). Produce a single composite score used by alerting rules.
Privacy: PII scrub step before any payload leaves the control plane. Sensitive fields replaced with stable placeholders to preserve diff signal without leaking data.
Storage: store only diffs and summary metrics in eval index; raw shadow outputs retained for 30d only if redacted and flagged for debugging by SRE/PD teams.
Ops: create canary job that runs prober at 0.01% for first 48h after rollout of any cache/config change, then auto-bumps to target sample rate if stable.
postmortem_plan: If alert fires: collect top-50 failing traces, associated model/config snapshot, and recent rollout events within 4h window
Automated artifact bundle created and uploaded to incident bucket with link included in alert notification
If a regression is confirmed, trigger automated temporary fallback to bypass cache for affected route and open ENG rollback PR template
